name: What kind of compensation can a family receive in a neonatal injury case?

mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can a family receive in a neonatal injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Families in neonatal injury cases may seek compensation for various damages. This can include past and future medical expenses, such as hospital stays, surgeries, medications, and ongoing therapies like physical or occupational therapy. Compensation may also cover lost earning capacity for the child as an adult, pain and suffering, and the emotional distress experienced by the family. The specific types and amounts of compensation depend on the unique circumstances and severity of the child's injury.
acceptedAnswer.description: Families can receive compensation for medical expenses, future care, lost earning capacity, pain and suffering, and emotional distress.
